faqs.a:
The following words, terms and phrases, when used in this article, shall have the
               meanings ascribed to them in this section, except where the context clearly indicates
               a different meaning:
Alcohol
means 190 proof ethyl alcohol or any fermented malt beverage, as defined in the Colorado
               Beer Code, or alcoholic beverages or alcoholic liquors, as defined in the Colorado
               Liquor Code.
Arvada/Blunn Reservoir
or
reservoir
means the lake, dam, spillways, appurtenances, and lands owned by the city and designated
               as the "Arvada/Blunn Reservoir" in Ordinance No. 2153 and such lands are located in
               sections 2 and 3, township 3 south, range 70 west of the 6th principal meridian, and
               in section 34, township 2 south, range 70 west of the 6th principal meridian, Jefferson
               County, State of Colorado, and as such lands have been annexed to the city by Ordinance
               No. 2371 and by Ordinance No. 2396.
Controlled substances
means any drug or other substance or immediate precursor that is declared to be a
               controlled substance by the Colorado Controlled Substances Act and defined in C.R.S.
               § 12-22-303, as amended.
Disabled American Veteran
means any Colorado resident who has been awarded a Purple Heart or has a 30 percent
               or more service-connected disability as determined by the Department of Veterans Affairs.
Handicapped person
means any person who meets the definition of a "handicapped person" in C.R.S. § 42-4-1109(1)
               and who has been issued a distinguishing license plate by the state motor vehicle
               division pursuant to C.R.S. § 42-4-1109(2) or (2.5).
Reservoir ranger
means any person designated to exercise authority to enforce this article at the
               reservoir.
Senior citizen
means any person who is 62 years of age or older.
(Code 1981, § 22-22; Ord. No. 2577, § 2, 12-19-1988; Ord. No. 2956, § 4, 2-15-1993;
Ord. No. 4256, § 1, 3-21-2011
